verdict.rationale: Ramp documents rules-based workflows that automatically route requests by vendor type, spend category, or dollar amount, and notification workflows keyed to spend amount or team role. Policy-driven auto-approval and human-in-the-loop policies auto-approve routine spend and hold the rest, and webhooks push real-time event notifications for custom automations. Missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose rule builder (trigger/condition/action configuration beyond routing, approvals, and notifications), custom event-driven actions that don't need your own webhook-handling code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
